Diya graduated from Hawaiʻi Pacific University with a B.S. in Marine Biology in 2025. With a strong interest in genetics and aquaculture, her undergraduate research focused on DNA barcoding megalops (final stage crab larvae) from the Kona side of Hawaiʻi Island.

Contact: diyareddy.koukutla\@gmail.com
